row.title: Monthly Statistical Bulletin - June 2026
row.description:
Monthly Statistical Bulletin is a key publication focusing on comprehensive economic and financial statistics. It is released by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) on a Monthly basis.

https://www.sama.gov.sa/en-US/EconomicReports/Pages/MonthlyStatistics.aspx

row.title: GDP - Flash Estimate Q2/2026
row.description:
GDP Flash Estimates is a key publication focusing on providing early insights into the nation's economic performance through preliminary GDP growth rates. It is released by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) on a Quarterly basis.

https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/statistics-tabs?tab=436312&category=120038

row.title: Healthcare Establishments and Workforce Statistics Publication 2025
row.description:
Healthcare Establishments and Workforce Statistics is a key publication focusing on granular bifurcation of Healthcare establishments and workforce in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is released by GASTAT on an annual basis.

https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/statistics-tabs?tab=436312&category=2968800

row.title: International Trade, May 2026
row.description:
International Trade Statistics Report is a comprehensive statistical publication focusing on Saudi Arabia's merchandise trade data, encompassing exports, imports, and trade balances. It is released by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) on a Monthly basis.

https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/statistics-tabs?tab=436312&category=123481

row.title: Construction Cost Index, June 2026
row.description:
Construction Cost Index is a key publication focusing on tracking changes in construction material prices and overall construction costs in Saudi Arabia. It is released by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) on a monthly basis.

https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/statistics-tabs?tab=436312&category=3453505

row.title: Real Estate Price Index, Q2/ 2026
row.description:
The Real Estate Price Index (REPI) is a key publication focusing on measuring changes in real estate prices across residential, commercial, and agricultural sectors throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is released by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) on a Quarterly basis.

https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/statistics-tabs?tab=436312&category=121920

row.title: Short-term Business Statistics, May 2026
row.description:
Short-term Business Statistics is a key publication focusing on providing fast-paced economic data that is used to measure the performance of various economic activities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is released by GASTAT on a monthly basis.

https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/statistics-tabs?tab=436312&category=123342

row.title: Consumer Price Index, June 2026
row.description:
Consumer Price Index (CPI) Monthly Report is a key publication focusing on tracking consumer inflation rates and price changes across various consumer categories in Saudi Arabia. It is released by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) on a monthly basis.

https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/statistics-tabs/-/categories/121421?tab=436312&category=121421

row.title: Average Prices of Goods and Services, June 2026
row.description:
The Average Prices of Goods and Services report is a key publication focusing on tracking price changes of essential goods and services in Saudi Arabia. It is released by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) on a monthly basis.

https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/statistics-tabs?tab=436312&category=121662

row.title: Industrial Production Index, May 2026
row.description:
The Industrial Production Survey is a key publication focusing on measuring industrial sector activities and production trends in Saudi Arabia. It is released by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) on a monthly basis.

https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/statistics-tabs?tab=436312&category=123454

row.title: Business Confidence Index, June 2026
row.description:
Business Confidence Index is a key publication focusing on perceptions and expectations regarding future developments in the non-oil business sector, based on survey opinions related to outputs, inputs, employment, and business development or expansion activities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is released by GASTAT on a monthly basis.

https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/statistics-tabs?tab=436312&category=1340144

row.title: Tourism Statistics (Establishments) Q1/2026
row.description:
Tourism Statistics (Establishments) is a key publication focusing on the performance, distribution, and economic impact of tourism-related activities in Saudi Arabia. It is released by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) on a quarterly basis.

https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/statistics-tabs?tab=436312&category=124304
